objective: Does the engine obey the plan? For built projects, the traps their plan caught that code can enforce (a column known only after the outcome, rows of one entity on both sides of the split, a split that should be by time) are counted against what the project actually did: its forbidden columns, its final model's features, its split. PE-001 is the baseline, read at no cost from a live run kept on 2026-11-13, before the Hierarchical Planning repair.
rule: Counted by code from stored records; no model judges it. A trap code cannot enforce is never counted as enforced. The gate hp_gate_v1 was pinned before the repair's first change; its verdict is read on held-out tables, once.
